description: GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, including PostgreSQL's optional parenthesized sequence-option list (which sqlite3 has no equivalent for and this parser simply discards -- see skipParenGroup in ddl.go), still rewrites to a working AUTOINCREMENT column

body: CREATE TABLE tD{{DLID}} (id INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1) PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)

tests.name: id auto-generated as 1 despite sequence options
